tutorials.title: AI Chat Feature
tutorials.description: Learn how to use AI chat for intelligent Q&A
steps: Click 'AI Chat' in the left navigation to enter the chat page
Choose an appropriate AI model (different models have different coin costs)
Enter your question or request in the input box
Click the send button, and AI will generate an answer for you
You can continue asking follow-up questions, AI remembers the context
Conversations are automatically saved and can be viewed in history

tutorials.title: AI Image Generation
tutorials.description: Create unique artworks through text descriptions
steps: Go to the 'Image Generation' page
Select an image generation model
Describe the image you want in detail in the input box
The more detailed the description, the better the generated image matches expectations
Click the generate button and wait for AI to create
Generated images can be downloaded and saved

tutorials.title: Document Processing
tutorials.description: Upload PDF and Word documents for intelligent analysis
steps: Go to the 'Document Processing' page
Click the upload button to select a file (supports PDF, Word)
Files are automatically uploaded to the cloud
Choose processing method (text extraction, summarization, analysis, etc.)
AI will process the document and return results
Processing records are saved in the file list

tutorials.title: Speech to Text
steps: Select an audio file on the 'Document Processing' page
Supports MP3, WAV, M4A and other formats
After uploading, select the 'Speech to Text' function
AI will automatically recognize and transcribe audio content
Transcription results can be copied or downloaded
Supports multiple language recognition

faqs.question: What are coins? How to get coins?
faqs.answer: Coins are the platform's virtual currency used to pay for AI services. New users get 100 coins upon registration. You can purchase more coins through the recharge page, the more you recharge, the more bonus you get!

faqs.question: How many coins do different AI models consume?
faqs.answer: Different models have different consumption rates, which will be displayed when you use them. Generally, more powerful models consume more coins. You can check the consumption details of each model in the model selector.

faqs.question: How long are conversation histories saved?
faqs.answer: All conversation histories are permanently saved. You can view and continue previous conversations anytime in the history section of the chat page.

faqs.question: Are uploaded files secure?
faqs.answer: Your files are encrypted and stored in the cloud, accessible only by you. We use enterprise-grade security measures to protect your data privacy.

faqs.question: Do generated images have copyright?
faqs.answer: Images generated through AI are owned by you and you can use them freely. However, please note not to generate content that infringes on others' copyrights or violates laws.

faqs.question: How to recharge coins?
faqs.answer: Click 'Recharge Coins' in the left navigation to enter the recharge page, select an appropriate package and payment method (Alipay or WeChat), and coins will be credited immediately after payment.

faqs.question: Can coins be refunded?
faqs.answer: Coins cannot be refunded after recharge. Please choose an appropriate recharge package according to your actual needs. For special circumstances, please contact customer service.

faqs.question: How to view coin consumption records?
faqs.answer: Click 'Coin Records' to view detailed consumption and recharge records, including time, amount, type and other information, as well as balance trend charts.

faqs.question: Is there a character limit for AI conversations?
faqs.answer: Both input and output of a single conversation have character limits, which depend on the model you choose. If you need to process long texts, it is recommended to do it in segments.

faqs.question: How to get better AI answers?
faqs.answer: Provide clear and detailed question descriptions with sufficient context. For image generation, describe details, style, colors, etc. For document processing, ensure files are clear and readable.
